sourceMarkup: {{EventEnded|date = 15th of January 2023|event = [[Violent Night Event#Violent Night Season Pass|Violent Night Event]]}} {{CurrencyInfobox |title = Candy Cane |image-static = Candy Cane.png |image-dynamic = CandyCaneDynamic.png |type = {{Color|Event}} }} ==Description== '''Candy Cane''' was a form of non-spendable season currency that could be earned during the [[Violent Night Event]] on any map and gamemode. It was obtained by killing enemies with Christmas themed hats, most of them being hats worn by enemies in the [[Violent Night Event]], such as presents or Christmas hats. Any naturally spawned enemy could spawn with one of these Christmas-themed hats and it would drop from one to three '''Candy Canes'''. It was used to complete Ranks on the [[Violent Night Event#Violent Night Season Pass|Violent Night Season Pass]].
